STRATHMORE UNIVERSITY
SCHOLARHIP PROGRAM
I&M Bank made a donation of KShs. 14 million over 3
years to Strathmore for 10 scholarships for the pioneer
students in the University’s new degrees in Actuarial
Science, Finance, and Financial Economics. The funds
will ensure bright but needy students can further their
education at Strathmore.
